articles.title: Blushed Clearcoat
articles.summary: Soft pink rose-violet lacquer with milky white veils, condensation streaks and trapped droplets. Reads as a cloudy pink-and-plum blotchy surface with a frosted white haze; the web and dots blur into a milky veil over soft rose patches.
articles.what: Moisture whitens rose-violet lacquer into fine milky veils, with binder pockets, condensation stringers, small trapped droplets and surviving polished pigment. Up close: Mottled rose, plum and cream-pink clouds 100 to 200 px across, covered by a web of translucent milky-lilac squiggles and tiny pale dots like condensation beads. Faint peach specks sit in the lighter zones, and the dark plum areas look bruised. From a distance: Reads as a cloudy pink-and-plum blotchy surface with a frosted white haze; the web and dots blur into a milky veil over soft rose patches. Measured spec (average): metal 63, roughness 106, coat 119. Shine: satin. Metal: low. It brings its own colours.
